title: OPTDRV-003: Raspberry Pi exposure completion can block forever
description:
OPTDRV-003: Raspberry Pi exposure completion can block forever. `exposure_timer_callback()` polls `IsAnyRequestComplete()` with no timeout while `state` never changes, and then `ReadFrame()` waits on `m_cv` with no cancellation/timeout. If libcamera drops a completion, a request was never queued, or the camera is stopped during the wait, the INDIGO timer callback can hang and leave exposure properties busy. Add a bounded wait and fail the exposure with cleanup. Next: revalidate historical evidence and assign a scoped repair task; no risk acceptance or closure is implied.

Imported from .factory/findings/archive/FND-000021.json (category: functional, blocking: no).
